overview.description: PCR uses heating/cooling cycles to make a polymerase replicate the region between two primers, doubling product each cycle until millions of copies exist by ~25 cycles. Set up a master mix, distribute, add your variable, and let the machine work while you have a sandwich.
objectives: assemble a master mix and distribute reactions
program thermocycler variables for your amplicon

steps.intro: PCR uses heating/cooling cycles to make a polymerase replicate the region between two primers, doubling product each cycle until millions of copies exist by ~25 cycles. Set up a master mix, distribute, add your variable, and let the machine work while you have a sandwich.

instructions.title: Build a master mix
instructions.description: Combine water, buffer, dNTPs, polymerase and primers common to all reactions; add polymerase last on ice.

instructions.title: Distribute & add template
instructions.description: Split the mix into tubes and add each template/variable.

instructions.title: Program the cycler
instructions.description: Set initial denaturation, then 25-35 cycles of denature/anneal/extend, using the NEB Tm Calculator for annealing temperature.

instructions.title: Check on a gel
instructions.description: Run the product on an agarose gel to confirm a band of the expected size.

submission.description: Amplify a target region and submit a gel showing a clean single band at the expected size.
